correctness.rationale: Every arrangement automorphism preserves component degree, hence lies in the six-line stabilizer. Exact rational projective-frame enumeration gives exactly \(24\) line-skeleton symmetries and realizes \(S_4\) on the four triple-concurrency classes. Testing the exact six conic quadratic forms leaves exactly six maps, all fixing one concurrency class; explicit generators satisfy the \(S_3\) relations. The packaged standard-library verifier also checks smoothness of the conics, component orbits, and the two added-line orbits. This is exhaustive over \(\operatorname{PGL}_3(\mathbb C)\), not a finite sampling argument.

value.rationale: The stabilizer is a natural invariant of the explicit embedded arrangement and directly organizes the addition-deletion examples that motivate the source. The result explains a nontrivial symmetry breaking from the \(S_4\) line skeleton to \(S_3\) after the conics are imposed, and turns two isolated addition representatives into complete symmetry orbits of three free and six plus-one generated additions. This is structural information useful for projective equivalence, moduli, and avoiding redundant computations; it is not merely a renamed or numerically sampled invariant.
